concerns.text: Task T020 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it implicitly depends on the successful completion of *all* preceding analysis tasks because it validates their output contracts. Running it in parallel with those producers would cause false failures. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T021 is also tagged `[P]` yet it requires the full pipeline to have run twice to compare hashes. This creates a hard dependency on the entire prior workflow, making the parallel‑safe designation incorrect.
